en.title: Contact DBS
en.h1: If any of the information on your DBS Online Result is incorrect
en.p1: You need to raise a dispute with DBS. This includes any:
en.linkText1: read the DBS certificate dispute and fingerprint consent form guidance (opens in a new tab)
en.p5: Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm (except public holidays)
en.linkText3: read the call charges guidance (opens in a new tab)
en.p7: to find out how much this should cost.
en.insetText: If your result shows any information that does not relate to you, you should consider informing the person or organisation who asked you to obtain it as soon as possible.
en.h5: If you need help with anything else
en.p8: For example with viewing or sharing your DBS Online Result, contact us using the information below.
en.bullet10: Relay UK: If you have difficulty with your speech or hearing, dial 18001 then 03000 200 192
en.bullet11-a: Convo: If you are a British Sign Language (BSL) user, you can
en.bullet11-b: use Convo to connect to DBS (opens in a new tab)
en.p10: Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm (except public holidays)
en.linkText5: Find out about call charges (opens in a new tab).

cy.title: Gyda phwy ydych chi'n rhannu eich canlyniad ar-lein?
cy.p1: TByddan nhw'n gweld enw'r sefydliad rydych chi'n ei nodi yma.
